notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi all!



Thank you all for playing the Isles Of Rain Demo. This small update brings some changes based on feedback.



Notes:

Camera Vertical Movement will now stay where you move it to

Camera will now only collide with specific objects rather than everything

Added more variety of music to the game

Re-balanced all sound effects and audio

Picking up marbles will now only show the dialogue prompt once

Overlay will now properly display cold or warm state rather than flash when cold

Made it a bit more obvious that the houses can be entered



Please continue to provide any feedback and suggestions!
